eq: 採取器のeq判定は `"neg" if (roicg is not None and False) else "pos"`(hachimon_fetch.py L265)で常時"pos"を返すバグ既定値。ORLYはStockholdersEquityが2021年以降マイナス(2021 -66.4→2022 -1,060.8→2023 -1,739.3→2024 -1,371.0→2025 -1,357.5百万USD)の債務超過。eq="neg"へ修正。【負資本の由来=重点検死】累積自社株買い(自己株式控除)が利益剰余金を上回り株主資本をマイナス化したもの。営業は健全にFCFを創出(FY2025 OCF2,762M・FCF1,593M)しており、負資本は信用毀損ではなく資本政策(積極的buyback)由来。純負債1.47xのレバレッジも同じ買戻し原資。

dilNet: ドラフト138.12%は2025/6の15対1株式分割をまたぐ希薄株数系列の断絶による虚偽CAGR。WtdShares 2022 64.4M→2023 907.1M(us-gaapは分割を遡及調整)、dei ShOut 2024 57.7M→2025 844.1M(表紙は申告時点で反映)と分割反映タイミングが不整合。分割株数断絶で再現不能→null化(誤値より空欄)。実態は継続的買戻しで純減(希薄化はマイナス)。
sbc: 採取器は固定Noneのため原本XBRLから充填。ShareBasedCompensation FY2025=35.1百万USD(=0.04十億)。SBC/NI=1.4%で希薄化文化は極小(株主還元は買戻し主導)。

roic/roicg: 負資本により株主資本ベースIC(eq+debt)が過小となりequityベースROICは不安定・過大化しやすい。参考(kenshi_helper・資本ベース): ROIC(のれん込み)FY2025=58.7%/(のれん除き)=73.7%、5年ROICσ=4.9pt。ドラフトroic63.4/roicg51.6はこのレンジ内につき維持し、負資本歪みを注記。roict=downは込み70.5%(2022)→58.7%(2025)で確認。

検算一致: nde=1.47=(debtL6,017+debtS0-cash194)/(op3,460.6+D&A511.2=EBITDA3,972)。gm=19.5は営業利益率(採取器gm=op/rev・hits『operating income…19.5% of sales』)で粗利率は51.6%。cagr8.9=売上5年CAGR(2020 11.6→2025 17.8十億)。fcf1.59・ni2.54・accr-1.4・gpa55.5(9.17/16.5)いずれも原本と一致。eps3.01は分割後(NI2,538M/約853M株)・分割前換算では約$45。
acq5: 有機成長主体で大型M&Aほぼ無し。PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesはXBRL 2008年のみで5年買収累計は算出不能→null維持。
2026-07-29 ROIC機械検算: roic 63.4→64.0 / roicg 51.6→51.6 / nde 1.47→1.47。自己資本−763百万$だがIC=+4,234百万$（|自己資本|の555%）＝自己株買いによる資本構成。負債6,017百万$が上回る

evidence.dom: 『The sale of automotive aftermarket items is highly competitive in many areas, including customer service, product availability, store location, and price.』+『In 2025, we derived approximately 50% of our sales from our DIY customers and approximately 50% of our sales from our professional service provider customers.』→大手数社+独立店の競争市場で単独シェア<40%=50(DIFM二重市場の堀はrep/dur/irr側で評価)
evidence.irr: 『the acquisition of automotive products by our professional service provider customers is substantially dependent upon our ability to provide, in a timely fashion, the correct automotive products needed to complete their repairs. Accordingly, each O'Reilly store carries, or has same or next day availability to, a broad selection of automotive products』→修理中の即時在庫可用性依存で高摩擦=70(認証ロックではなく代替は存在)
evidence.rep: 『New store sites are strategically located in clusters within geographic areas that complement our distribution network in order to achieve economies of scale in management, advertising, and distribution.』+『We currently operate a total of 399 strategically located Hub stores.』→全国的な同日/翌日可用の物流網は数十年・$10B級で複製極困難=80
evidence.dur: 『economies of scale in management, advertising, and distribution』+Hub-and-spoke網による同日/翌日在庫可用=店舗クラスター+Hub+DCの分配網密度(ネットワーク型物流の堀)=85
evidence.erosion: 『increased use of technology…on future vehicles, including but not limited to electric, hybrid, and internal combustion engines, may result in less frequent repairs, parts lasting longer, or elimination of certain repairs』+『online competitors may allow customers to quickly compare prices…which could result in pricing pressure』→EV移行・オンライン価格圧力=emerging(顕在化は未)
evidence.disrupt: 『restrictions on access to telematics, diagnostic tools, and repair information imposed by the OEMs or by governmental regulations may force vehicle owners to rely on dealers to perform maintenance and repairs』→EV/テレマティクス/修理権の技術転換は未決着=unsettled
evidence.expiry: 限セクション=ヒットなし。コンセッション・特許束依存のない恒久的小売業態=no
evidence.geopol: 国内(米国)完結の小売でコンセッション/単一国政治依存なし。地政学ヒット無し→0(軽微)
evidence.moatdecay: 『We remain confident in our ability to continue to gain market share in our existing markets and grow our business in new markets』+『increasing total light vehicle fleet, will support continued demand for automotive aftermarket products』→堀本体(物流網)は非減衰=no
evidence.nrr: 小売業態で開示なし→既定105
evidence.p1: kenshi_helper: 資本ベースROIC 5年σ=4.9pt(<6pt)→80。負資本による株主資本ベースROICの過大化ではなく資本ベース系列で評価
evidence.p2: OperatingIncome 2019 1,920.7→2020(COVID) 2,419.3百万USD(+26%)。2008-09も増益。景気後退時に修理需要が増える防衛的業態でDDほぼ無し(浅い)→95
evidence.p3: nde=1.47(<2.5)→70。純負債は自社株買いのレバレッジ由来で事業起因ではない

evidence.f1: 負資本でIC(eq+debt)が歪みROIIC(ΔNOPAT/ΔIC)がクリーンに計算不能→還元の質で判定。高ROIC下の規律ある自社株買い+選択的高収益出店(capex 2023 1,006→2025 1,169百万で成長投資継続)→75

evidence.f3: R&D該当なし業態。シェア趨勢は『continue to gain market share』で+(片方)→75。DIY/DIFM分散で顧客集中悪化なし(-10適用せず)
